text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I made it all the way to the end, 
Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
With this, all physical concerns have been 
completely eliminated. All that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to show a flawless run 
at the Japan Cup...
choice_data_list: Let's get started on the adjustments!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...So with this, my Classic Triple Crown 
races have come to an end, haven't they?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The resolve of the others, my own 
immaturity... These past six months have 
taught me so much.
choice_data_list:
Let's connect all of this to what lies 
ahead.
